chunks.arabic_text: إِقْبَالُ السَّيِّدِ رَضِي الدِّينِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ طَاوُسٍ: بِأَسَانِيدِهِ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الطُّوسِيِّ، عَنِ الْمُفِيدِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِاللَّهِ، عَن أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ بَابَوَيْهَ، عَن مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَن مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ، عَن مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ، عَن مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَن إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: إِنَّ أَبَا عَبْدِاللَّهِ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ كَتَبَ إِلَى عَبْدِاللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ رَضِيِاللَّهُ عَنْهُ حِينَ حُمِلَ هُوَ وَأَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ يَعِيزِيهِ عَمَّا صَارَ إِلَيْهِ

translations.en: Iqbal of Sayyid Radhi al-Din Ali ibn Tawus: Via his chains to Abi Ja'far al-Tusi, from al-Mufid Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man and al-Husayn ibn Ubaydallah, from Abi Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar who said: Indeed Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them) wrote to Abdullah ibn al-Hasan (may Allah be pleased with him) when he and the people of his household were deported, condoling him for what had befallen him:

chunks.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِلَى الْخَلِيفِ الصَّالِحِ وَالذَّرِّيَّةِ الطَّيِّبَةِ مِنْ وَلَدِ أَخِيهِ وَابْنِ عَمِّهِ: أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَلِإِنَّكَ إِن تَفَرَّدْتَ أَنتَ وَأَهْلُ بَيْتِكَ مِمَّنْ حُمِلَ مَعَكَ بِمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مَا انْفَرَدْتَ بِالْحُزْنِ وَالْغَيْظَةِ وَالْكَآبَةِ وَأَلِيمِ وَجَعِ الْقَلْبِ دُونِي، فَلَقَدْ نَالَنِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْجَزَعِ وَالْقَلَقِ وَحَرِّ الْمَصِيبَةِ مِثْلُ مَا نَالَكَ …

translations.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful, to the righteous successor and the pure descendant from the son of his brother and uncle: Now then, if you and the people of your house who were deported with you are alone in that which has befallen you, then know that you are not alone in grief, anger, sadness and pain of a suffering heart without me, for I too have been touched with anxiety, worry and the heat of tribulation [for what has happened to you] as has touched you …

chunks.arabic_text: فَعَلَيْكُمْ يَا عَمَّ وَابْنَ عَمٍّ وَبُنَيَّ عُمُومَتِي وَإِخْوَتِي بِالصَّبْرِ وَالرِّضَا وَالتَّسْلِيمِ وَالتَّفْوِيضِ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَالرِّضَا بِالصَّبْرِ عَلَى قَضَائِهِ، وَالْتِّمَاسِ بِطَاعَتِهِ، وَالنُّزُولِ عِنْدَ أَمْرِهِ. أَفْرَغَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَيْكُمُ الصَّبْرَ، وَخَتَمَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ بِالْأَجْرِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ، وَأَنْقَذَنَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ هَلَكَةٍ، بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ صَفْوَتَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ النَّبِيُّ وَأَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ

translations.en: So I recommend you – O uncle and the son of an uncle, the children of my uncles and my brothers – towards patience, acceptance, submission and leaving the matter to Allah Mighty and Majestic. Be accepting and patient over His decree, holding on to His obedience, alighting as per His order. May Allah pour upon you and us patience. May He conclude for you and us with reward and felicity. May He save you and us from every peril. By His Might and Power. Verily He is All-Hearing Near. May Allah send blessings on his select among his creation Muhammad the prophet and the people of his House.

en.summary: This epistle from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) to Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, recorded in al-Mufid's chain within *Mujam al-Ahadith*, exemplifies the Alid tradition of mutual consolation during political exile, blending personal grief with theological resilience. It emphasizes *sabr* (patience) and *rida* (contentment) as active spiritual disciplines, urging the recipient to submit to divine decree while maintaining steadfastness in obedience to God.
en.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq write to Abdullah ibn al-Hasan during his exile?
